ceu: ✦ The square between Venus and Mars

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between conversations and routine. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Picture your ideal future for five minutes, in detail.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between money and romance. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Finish one important task before starting another.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your image and family. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Say a prayer or set an intention for your path.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Take a deep breath whenever you feel jealousy or distrust.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between friendships and money. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask the person beside you how you can help.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your career and your image. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Get up from your chair every hour and stretch.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Show someone what you have created, without fear of criticism.

t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Offer help to someone in your family without waiting to be asked.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your career. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Call a brother, sister, cousin or neighbour just to see how they are.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between romance and intimacy. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The square between Venus and Mars creates some tension between family and relationships. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.
